notes: Proved without Mathlib's AM-GM (no geom_mean_le_arith_mean_weighted). With a = AM > 0: prod(x_i/a) <= exp(sum(x_i/a - 1)) = 1 gives prod <= a^n; strictness via log t < t - 1 for t != 1 (after splitting off a zero entry). Case a = 0 handled separately. Fixed API drift: prod_lt_prod is now the ordered-group version, so strictness is done through sums of logs.
